controls.micTitleDeafened: Uvale izindlebe — vula izindlebe ukuze ususe ukuthulisa
controls.micLabelPushToTalk: Ukucindezela ukuze ukhulume kulungile. Bamba {{combo}} ukuze udlulise

stage.speakerUnavailable: Asikho isipikha — ngeke uzwe muntu kuze kube khona idivayisi yokukhipha umsindo.

share.heading: Yabelana ngesikrini
share.audioScopeSystem: Yabelana ngakho konke ikhompyutha yakho ekudlalayo.

inputMode.heading: Indlela Yokufaka
inputMode.voiceActivityHint: Imakrofoni yakho ivuleka noma nini lapho ungathulisiwe. Kungcono ngama-headphone nasekamelweni elithule.
inputMode.pushToTalkHint: Imakrofoni yakho ivaliwe kuze kube ubamba <combo>{{combo}}</combo>, futhi iphinde ivaleke ngokushesha uma uyeka — noma uma iwindi lingasagxilile. Yishintshe ku-Izinqamuleli Zekhibhodi.

channel.deleteWarning: Lesi siteshi sezwi nanoma yisiphi isimo sekholi kuzosuswa unomphela. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.

call.unreachable: Akafinyeleleki manje — ayikho idivayisi yakhe exhunyiwe.

settings.title: Izwi Nevidiyo
settings.speaker: Isipikha
settings.previewOff: Ukubuka kuqala kuvaliwe — kuvule ukuze uhlole ikhamera yakho.
settings.hearMyselfDescription: Ibuyisela imakrofoni ngokuphumayo okukhethiwe. Sebenzisa ama-headphone ukuze ugweme ukunanela.
settings.micBoostSublabel: Yengeza ivolumu eyengeziwe emakrofonini yakho ngaphambi kokuthi kucutshungulwe noma yini. Kusebenzise uma usathule kakhulu ngisho nevolumu yesistimu igcwele.
settings.autoVolumeLevelingDescription: Igcina izwi lakho lisezingeni elifanayo — inkulumo ethule iyakhuliswa, ukuqhuma okukhulu kuyancishiswa. Kuvale uma ungathanda ukusetha ivolumu yemakrofoni ngokwakho.
settings.autoVolumeTargetSublabel: Ukuthi Ukulinganisa Ivolumu Ngokuzenzakalela kuzama ukukwenza uzwakale kangakanani. Okuphansi = kukhulu kakhulu (u-3 angase ahlikize umsindo kumakrofoni enamandla), okuphezulu = kuthule kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bayajabula ngo-6.
settings.noiseSuppressionHint: Ihlunga ukuhayiza kwangemuva, amafeni, nomsindo wezimoto. Izilungiselelo eziphezulu nazo zisusa inkulumo ethule, ngakho shiya ku-Phakathi ngaphandle uma igumbi lakho linomsindo.
settings.echoCancellationDescription: Ivimbela umsindo wesipikha sakho ukuthi ungathathwa yimakrofoni yakho bese ubuyiselwa kwabanye. Shiya kuvuliwe ngaphandle uma uhlale usebenzisa ama-headphone.
settings.clickSuppressionDescription: Isihlungi somsindo esihlakaniphe kakhudlwana esibamba ukuthayipha kwekhibhodi nokuchofoza kwegundane okungabanjwa Ukunciphisa Umsindo okujwayelekile. Sisebenzisa cishe u-5% we-core eyodwa ye-CPU. Ithiphu: yehlisa Ukunciphisa Umsindo kube Phansi noma Kuvaliwe uma lokhu kuvuliwe ukuze kungalwisani.
settings.fpsHint: {{hint}}. Okuphezulu kubushelelezi kakhulu kuvidiyo nemidlalo kodwa kusebenzisa i-CPU nomkhawulokudonsa omningi; yehlisela ku-15 fps kumadokhumenti noma emshinini/enethiwekhini elinganiselwe. Kusebenza lapho uphinde wabelana ngesikrini.
settings.shareResolutionHint: Ibeka umkhawulo wobukhulu besikrini sakho esabiwe esithunyelwayo. U-1080p ulungele amakholi amaningi; Umthombo uthumela ubukhulu obugcwele besikrini sakho, okudla i-CPU nomkhawulokudonsa omningi kusikrini se-4K noma se-Retina. Ushintsho lusebenza ngokushesha, nakukwabelana osekuvele kuqhubeka.
settings.cameraResolutionHint: Ibeka umkhawulo wobukhulu bekhamera yakho ethunyelwayo. Umthombo uthumela lokho ikhamera yakho ekuthwebulayo; isilungiselelo esiphansi songa i-CPU nomkhawulokudonsa emshinini noma kunethiwekhi ehamba kancane. Ushintsho lusebenza ngokushesha, nakukhamera esivele ivuliwe.
settings.autoJoinVoiceDescription: Joyina izwi ngokuzenzakalela uma uvula isiteshi sezwi. Vala ukuze ubone kuqala ukuthi ubani osesiteshini ngaphambi kokujoyina.
settings.screenShareAudioDescription: Faka umsindo wekhompyutha yakho uma wabelana ngesikrini. Ikholi ngokwayo ayilokothi ifakwe. Ku-Linux le yindawo yodwa yokukuvula, ngoba ibhokisi lesistimu yilo elikhetha umthombo.

joinError.unreachable: Ayikwazanga ukufinyelela iseva yezwi — hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
joinError.noMlsGroup: Okhiye bale ngxoxo abakabi kule divayisi — yivule kanye, bese uzama futhi.
joinError.tokenRejected: Iseva yezwi yenqabe iziqinisekiso zale divayisi. Zama futhi emzuzwini.
joinError.publishFailed: Ixhunyiwe, kodwa imakrofoni ayikwazanga ukushicilelwa. Zama futhi.
joinError.deadline: Ukujoyina kuthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi kwayekwa. Zama futhi.

disconnected.lost: Uxhumano lwezwi lulahlekile — phinda ujoyine isiteshi ukuze uqhubeke.

shareError.cancelled: Ukwabelana ngesikrini kukhanseliwe — alikho iwindi noma isikrini esikhethiwe.
shareError.unsupportedDesktop: Ukwabelana ngesikrini akutholakali kule ndawo yedeskithophu. Ayinayo i-backend yokwabelana ngesikrini (xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast). Sebenzisa i-GNOME, i-KDE, noma iseshini ye-X11.
shareError.permission: Vumela i-Pollis ku-macOS Privacy → Screen Recording.
shareError.helperMissing: Umsizi wokwabelana ngesikrini akekho. Phinda ufake i-Pollis ukuze umbuyise.
shareError.portal: Ukwabelana ngesikrini akutholakali — i-portal yedeskithophu yokwabelana ngesikrini ayiphendulanga.

cameraError.permission: Ukufinyelela kwekhamera kuvinjiwe. Nikeza i-Pollis imvume yekhamera, bese uzama futhi.
cameraError.busy: Ikhamera isetshenziswa olunye uhlelo lokusebenza. Luvale bese uzama futhi.
cameraError.helperMissing: Umsizi wekhamera akekho. Phinda ufake i-Pollis ukuze umbuyise.
